name: @anhtranhai835/verid
description: Evidence-verified, hook-enforced TDD harness for Claude Code
author: Anh Tran

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild hook=src/hook-entry.ts cli=src/cli/entry.ts --bundle --splitting --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=dist --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --exclude test/e2e/installers.e2e.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test:full
